title: HCC+: Hyperbolic Guarding for Certified Attention Retrieval
abstract: arXiv:2608.24971v1 Announce Type: cross  Abstract: We study the Lipschitz stability of attention retrieval in hyperbolic spaces. Existing methods lack deterministic guarantees on attention-weight preservation under finite-precision representations. We introduce HCC+, a theoretical framework exploiting three properties of the Poincar\'e ball: exponential volume growth enabling query-independent boundary truncation; logarithmic covering radius of hyperbolic 1-centers enabling dimension-independent critical-key identification; and a packing bound with constants independent of the embedding dimension. We prove two deterministic guarantees: for exact retrieval, the per-layer attention deviation is bounded by 10\% of its ideal value; for soft attention, the total variation distance decays as $O(1/\sqrt{n})$, the rate of finite-sample variance. translated_title: HCC+：用于认证注意力检索的双曲守护机制
translated_abstract: 我们研究了双曲空间中注意力检索的Lipschitz稳定性。现有方法在有限精度表示下缺乏对注意力权重保持的确定性保证。我们引入了HCC+，一个理论框架，利用庞加莱球的三个性质：指数体积增长实现查询无关的边界截断；双曲1-中心的对数覆盖半径实现维度无关的关键键识别；以及一个与嵌入维度无关的常数打包界。我们证明了两个确定性保证：对于精确检索，每层注意力偏差被限制在其理想值的10%以内；对于软注意力，总变差距离以$O(1/\sqrt{n})$的速率衰减，即有限样本方差的速率。作为守护机制的副产品，该框架相对于FP16实现了$6.1\times$的存储缩减因子。我们提供了首个去...
tldr: 本文提出了HCC+框架，利用双曲空间的几何特性为注意力检索提供确定性保证，实现了注意力偏差控制在10%以内、总变差距离按O(1/√n)衰减，并达到6.1倍的存储压缩。
en_tdlr: This paper introduces HCC+, a framework leveraging hyperbolic geometry to provide deterministic guarantees for attention retrieval, bounding attention deviation within 10%, achieving total variation decay of O(1/√n), and yielding 6.1x storage compression.
